title: Eagles made play for Myles Garrett, but Browns wanted Jalen Carter

sources.title: Eagles made play for Myles Garrett, but Browns wanted Jalen Carter
sources.description: On Monday morning, before the Browns traded defensive end Myles Garrett to the Rams, Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealer flagged the Rams, Cowboys, and Eagles as potential destinations.
